items.title: Who knew I would enjoy a Sergio de Larrea, Marcus Sasser, Walter Clayton Jr lineup this much?
items.author: Steve Jones
items.body_excerpt:
Who knew I would enjoy a Sergio de Larrea, Marcus Sasser, Walter Clayton Jr lineup this much? 

The best sign for Dallas early is they are building things that compliment their stars but open up a little bit of everything for everyone else.

items.title: Marcus Sasser and Andrew Nembhard with some extracurriculars. Jalen Slawson and Quenton Jackson, as they do, get in the middle of it. Jackson tells the Pacers bench to stay away. A combustible group on the floor for the Pacers. To their credit they've been battling this stretch.
